Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
CONTROLS (observed): WASD moves (w up, s down, a left, d right); arrow keys fire tears in that direction; movement and firing can be combined in one action; 'wait' delays; pointer/mouse can hover over UI (e.g. minimap). Movement speed approx 25px per 0.5s step (guess). Tears travel in straight lines and are blocked by rocks/barrels/chests.

MECHANICS (observed): Contact with enemies/projectiles damages player; HUD shows red hearts with empty outlines when lost. Enemies seen: gray winged flies; tanky fat red-eyed enemies that flash red near death and switch to a skull-face enraged form; small blue orbs/droplets that chase; fast blue spiders; cup-shaped spawner enemies that emit blue orbs; a blue goo spawner; a fire-skull enemy; hooded blob shapes; a blue-eyed skull embedded in a wall (hazard or launcher - unconfirmed). A green blob appeared then dissipated harmlessly (temporary entity). TNT barrels and a bomb-with-fuse sprite in a TNT room did NOT explode or react to tears (observed); a lit bomb remained inert ~2s and did not self-detonate (observed). Gilded/golden poop mounds are suspected destructible item containers but repeated tear hits did not visibly break one (unresolved). A white sparkle appeared near a gilded mound (possible pickup - unobserved pickup).

DOOR/ROOM RULES (hypothesis, not confirmed): doors/hatches often fail to transition until the room's enemies are cleared; a bottom hatch stayed locked even when aligned and even after a spider died. Exact alignment with a door center is required - multiple slightly-off 'w' presses failed while centered presses eventually worked (observed in TNT room).

NAVIGATION RELATIONSHIPS (observed): Start room Basement I tutorial room with wall diagrams (move/attack/bomb/item), bottom doorway at start; its top door leads up to Room 2. Room 2: rock-filled, gold-locked door on left wall, enemies, green blob; top door leads up. Room 3: TNT room with barrels, two keyhole/locked chests on left wall, inert bomb sprite near left barrels; top-center door (needed exact centering, many failures) leads up. Room 4: rock room with fat enemies (they do take many hits), flies/droplets, brown spawner mound on right wall, top door at x≈0.43-0.48 leads up. Room 5 (wave room): appears to endlessly spawn blue orbs/spiders/spawners; gilded poop at right (~0.70,0.46); blue-eyed skull carving in right wall; only known exit is the bottom door back to Room 4, which never opened (locked while enemies present - unconfirmed). Minimap at top-right shows room layout with icons (skull, gold, red item) whose meanings are guessed.

FAILED STRATEGIES (learned): Fighting fat enemies at point-blank/contact range cost hearts; shooting through the central rock cluster wasted fire (rocks block tears); waiting on the inert bomb didn't trigger anything; trying to open the bottom hatch in the wave room while enemies were alive didn't work; trying to reach the gilded poop from the west was blocked by central rocks.

UNRESOLVED: whether doors unlock only on full room clear; whether the gilded poop is destructible and drops an item; whether the wave room can be cleared at all; meanings of minimap icons; whether the wall skull carving fires hazards.
